name: Conglomerate of Limbs
text:
You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs. You create a Huge thrall within range. This thrall has 40 Hit Points and a Speed of 25 feet.

When you use Thrall Charge to order this thrall to make a Strike, it makes two melee unarmed Strikes instead of one, each against a different creature within 10 feet. Your multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the thrall makes both Strikes. A creature hit by one of these Strikes must also succeed at a Fortitude save saving throw or become Grabbed by the thrall for 1 round (or Restrained on a critical failure) or until it Escapes. Attempts to Escape don't automatically succeed, and the Escape DC is your spell DC.

---
Heightened (+1) The thrall's Hit Points increase by 10.
